title: Hurricane Survival
description: Explains watches and warnings, the Saffir-Simpson categories (which measure wind only), and why storm surge and inland flooding cause most deaths. Covers when to evacuate, sheltering in place, and the carbon monoxide, electrocution, and heat dangers after the storm.
shortDescription: Evacuation zones, storm surge and flooding, and post-storm CO and electrocution
author: OfflineOwl Contributors
